items.title: File Widerspruch against the Grundsicherung decision
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei Kreisverwaltung Beispiel-Westerwald, Peter-Altmeier-Platz 2, 56410 Musterbaur einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter is dated Fri 20.11.2026, sent by simple post. The letter itself states Bekanntgabe occurs on the 4th day after posting (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X), counting calendar days from the posting day: 21.11 (day1,Sa), 22.11 (day2,Su), 23.11 (day3,Mo), 24.11 (day4,Tu) → delivery/Bekanntgabe = Tue 24.11.2026. As this is a social-law body (Sozialamt/SGB X), the delivery day itself does not shift for weekends/holidays (unlike tax offices) – but 24.11 is a Tuesday anyway, so no issue. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist runs from delivery (§ 84 SGG / § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X): the delivery day is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), the period ends one month later on the day bearing the same number (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 24.11.2026 → 24.12.2026. 24.12.2026 is a Thursday and a normal working day in RP (24 December is not a statutory holiday), so the deadline does not shift further (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 193 BGB would only move it if it fell on a weekend/holiday).

items.title: Start of Grundsicherung im Alter benefit payments
items.quote: Ab Dezember 2026 zahlen wir Ihnen monatlich 412,64 €.

warnings: The letter is dated Friday 20.11.2026 but uses the standard 4-day Bekanntgabefiktion for simple post under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X; since this authority is a social-law body (Sozialamt/Grundsicherung, governed by SGB X), the delivery day itself is not pushed to the next working day even though two of the four days fall on a weekend – only the deadline's own end date is protected by weekend/holiday rules, which in this case was not needed since 24.12.2026 is a working day.
